nameInUI: Lua profiler (diagnostic -- slows the mission while it runs)
descriptionInUI: Measures where the mission's Lua time goes and logs every sim-thread stall. Off by default; tick it for ONE flight when the sim is hitching, then untick it. Two outputs in Saved Games\DCS\Logs: MooseProfiler.txt (per-function CPU time, calls per second, sorted three ways -- names the script eating the sim thread, or shows Lua is small and the stall is DCS itself) and PROFILER| lines in dcs.log (one per stall longer than the threshold, with the mission time and Lua heap size, plus a 30 s heartbeat). The profiler hooks every Lua call, so the mission runs noticeably slower for the profiling window; the stall log runs the whole mission at no measurable cost.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Seconds after mission start before the function profiler hooks in. Leave spawn-in out of the window: every run hitches while models load.
Length of the profiling window. Five minutes covers the settled phase; the report is written when the window ends, or at mission end if that comes first.
A gap between two consecutive sim ticks longer than this is logged as a stall. 250 ms is a visible hitch; a one-second freeze reads ~1000.
